sections.title: 12-Day Art, Mosaic & Cultural Discovery Journey: Italy & Slovenia
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
12-Day Art, Mosaic & Cultural Discovery Journey: Italy & Slovenia

Experience a vibrant journey through Italy and Slovenia, exploring the rich artistic heritage of cities like Ravenna, Venice, and Ljubljana. Discover world-renowned mosaics, participate in hands-on workshops, and immerse yourself in local culture, cuisine, and history across picturesque towns and scenic landscapes.

sections.title: Day 1 - Arrival in Venice and Treviso
sections.html:
Arrival in Venice - Treviso

Meet the group at Venice Marco Polo Airport and travel by private coach to Treviso. Enjoy an afternoon at leisure exploring the city, with the option to walk through its historic center with the tour escort.

sections.title: Day 2 - Treviso to Ravenna Art Discovery
sections.html:
Travel to Ravenna

Travel to Ravenna and enjoy an introductory sightseeing tour.

Visit MAR, Museum of Art of the City of Ravenna

Visit MAR, the Museum of Art of the City of Ravenna, with an English-speaking guide.

sections.title: Day 3 - Ravenna: Mosaics and Artists
sections.html:
Guided visit to Mausoleum of Galla Placidia

Discover Ravenna’s remarkable mosaic heritage on a guided visit to the Mausoleum of Galla Placidia.

Guided visit to Basilica of San Vitale

Discover Ravenna’s remarkable mosaic heritage on a guided visit to the Basilica of San Vitale.

Guided visit to Basilica of Sant’Apollinare Nuovo

Discover Ravenna’s remarkable mosaic heritage on a guided visit to the Basilica of Sant’Apollinare Nuovo.

Visit Koko Mosaico

Visit Koko Mosaico in Ravenna.

Visit studio of artist Giuliano Babini

Visit the studio of artist Giuliano Babini in Ravenna.

sections.title: Day 4 - Ravenna - Venice
sections.html:
Travel to Venice and arrive by water taxi

Travel to Venice and arrive by water taxi. Settle in and enjoy free time in the city. A three-day vaporetto (water bus) pass provides flexibility to explore Venice and Murano.

sections.title: Day 5 - Venice: Glass and Modern Art
sections.html:
Visit Orsoni mosaic and glassmaking factory

Visit the Orsoni mosaic and glassmaking factory to learn about its traditional craft.

Guided visit to Peggy Guggenheim Collection

Enjoy a guided visit to the Peggy Guggenheim Collection.

sections.title: Day 6 - Venice: Historic Landmarks
sections.html:
Guided walking tour of Venice

Take a guided walking tour of Venice featuring St. Mark’s Basilica, the Doge’s Palace, its prisons, the Bridge of Sighs, and surrounding historic sites.

Optional excursion to Murano by vaporetto

The afternoon offers an optional excursion to Murano by vaporetto.

sections.title: Day 7 - Venice - Spilimbergo - Udine
sections.html:
Travel to Spilimbergo

Travel to Spilimbergo, celebrated for its mosaic tradition.

Visit the School of Mosaics

Visit the School of Mosaics and tour the town, including its historic church, loggias, cathedral, and castle district.

Visit studio of artist Dagmar Friedrich

Visit the studio of artist Dagmar Friedrich before continuing to Udine.

sections.title: Day 8 - Udine - Ljubljana
sections.html:
Hands-on mosaic workshop with Giulio Menossi

Take part in a hands-on mosaic workshop with artist Giulio Menossi, organized in small groups.

Explore Udine

Travelers not participating in the workshop may explore Udine.

Continue to Ljubljana

Continue to Ljubljana, with a possible sightseeing drive through Trieste if time permits.

sections.title: Day 9 - Ljubljana: City and Castle
sections.html:
Guided city tour of Ljubljana and castle

Enjoy a guided city tour of Ljubljana, including its castle.

Afternoon at leisure

Spend the afternoon at leisure.

Special group dinner at Restaurant Kuren

Enjoy a special group dinner at Restaurant Kuren.

sections.title: Day 10 - Lake Bled Excursion
sections.html:
Travel to Lake Bled

Travel to beautiful Lake Bled for time to explore its scenic surroundings.

Boat trip on Lake Bled

Enjoy a boat trip on Lake Bled.

Return to Ljubljana

Return to Ljubljana in the late afternoon.

sections.title: Day 11 - Idrija: Slovenian Culinary Traditions
sections.html:
Travel to Idrija

Travel to Idrija for a hands-on cooking workshop focused on žlikrofi, traditional Slovenian dumplings.

Hands-on cooking workshop

Participate in a hands-on cooking workshop focused on žlikrofi, traditional Slovenian dumplings. Learn the preparation process in small groups and sample locally prepared žlikrofi.

Explore Idrija

Enjoy some time to explore Idrija before traveling to the Venice airport area.

Travel to Venice airport area

Travel to the Venice airport area after your time in Idrija.

sections.title: Day 12 - Departure from Venice
sections.html:
Breakfast

After breakfast, transfer to Venice Marco Polo Airport for onward flights.

Transfer to Venice Marco Polo Airport

After breakfast, transfer to Venice Marco Polo Airport for onward flights.
